text:
maya: PSA: v1.12.0 release cutoff ~18h from now (tomorrow 10:00 PT). Please add compact changelog one-liners to the release-notes template and tag your component. Include PR numbers. Template: https://redwood/internal/release-notes/template.md

zach: Ack — I'm adding a one-liner for the runtime bump PR #4821 :thumbsup:

leo: Quick q — what's the exact format? bullet + component? example pls

maya: Format: single sentence, present tense. Prefix the component in square brackets and include the PR number in parens. Example: `[runtime] Improve kernel selection for short-sequence workloads (#4821)` Keep it under ~120 chars.

sophia: I can claim cloud-config entries — will add mine now.

tariq: Heads-up: I'm labelling related PRs with `release/v1.12` so the release script picks them up. Also tagging reviewers for backports.

release-bot: Reminder: changelog linter runs in CI and will fail if an entry is missing a component tag. You can run locally: ``ci/tools/changelog-lint --file=CHANGES.md``

zach: Sample one-liner I added: `[runtime] Fine-tune kernel selection for short sequences (#4821)`

maya: Thanks — tiny nit: prefer "short-sequence workloads" as wording. e.g. `Improve kernel selection for short-sequence workloads`

leo: Updated mine to: `[docs] Clarify changelog entry shape and examples (#4832)`

sophia: Done cloud-config entry and added PR link. @maya do we want an additional tag for config vs infra?

maya: Not necessary for now — use `[ops]` for ops-only changes, `[infra]` if it's infra-facing. Keep it simple.

tariq: Also: if you're bumping SDK versions and there are migration steps, add `(migration: minor)` or `(migration: none)` at the end so release notes can surface it.

maya: Good call — include migration note when applicable; not required for internal test-only bumps.

release-bot: Cutoff in 18:00:00. CHANGES.md merges will be frozen at cutoff.

zach: Merging PR now, pinging owners for review.

maya: Thanks all — if you miss cutoff, leave a note on the release board for post-cutoff backport consideration. :pray:
